coordinate_convention: WGS84 (EPSG:4326) latitude and east-positive longitude in -180..180.
footprint_definition: Square footprint of half-width 0.25 degrees (about 56 km N-S full width, 56*cos(lat) km E-W) centred on the site. Smaller than the Mars footprint because Earth analog field sites are typically a few tens of km across; terrain statistics are computed on a grid block-averaged to the MOLA 16 ppd cell size (~3.7 km, separately per axis) so they are comparable to the Mars values.

candidates.name: Atacama Desert - Yungay region
candidates.description: Hyperarid core of the Atacama near Yungay: playa sediments over alluvial fan deposits, and polygonal ground cemented by sulfates, nitrates and chlorides. Used by NASA ARADS for rover and drill testing.
known_analog_use: NASA ARADS rover and drilling campaigns

candidates.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys - University Valley
candidates.description: High-elevation hyper-arid polar desert (University Valley) with dry permafrost over ice-cemented ground; studied as a Mars analog for periglacial processes and ground ice.

candidates.name: Haughton impact structure
candidates.description: A 23 km diameter impact crater on Devon Island with impact breccia, gypsum bedrock, carbonates and hydrothermal deposits weathered to iron-oxide crusts. Home of the Haughton-Mars Project.
known_analog_use: Haughton-Mars Project (NASA Ames / Mars Institute / SETI)

candidates.name: Death Valley - central basin
candidates.description: Desert basin with dry lakebeds (playas) and polygon-patterned salt pans at Badwater Basin; its playa sediments hold clays, chloride and sulfate salts and borate minerals. Used as an analog for Gale crater's lake deposits.
known_analog_use: Named in the Space Apps challenge statement
Terrestrial analog for Gale crater lake deposits (Das et al., 2026)

candidates.name: Holuhraun lava field
candidates.description: Basaltic lava flow field from the 2014-2015 fissure eruption, emplaced on a floodplain of glacial and fluvial deposits; an analog for young volcanic terrains in Elysium Planitia.
known_analog_use: FELDSPAR analog sampling expedition (Stockton et al., 2019)
Analog for young volcanic terrains in Elysium Planitia (Voigt et al., 2025)

candidates.name: San Rafael Swell - MDRS area
candidates.description: Area around the Mars Desert Research Station near Hanksville, Utah: Jurassic and Cretaceous sandstone and shale with smectite clays and sulfate salts, and exhumed, inverted palaeochannels with carbonate concretions.
known_analog_use: Mars Desert Research Station crewed simulations

candidates.name: Mauna Kea volcano (summit-centred footprint)
candidates.description: Summit region of Mauna Kea: tephra cones such as Pu'u Poli'ahu, which holds a hematite-bearing outcrop, and upper flanks used for NASA rover and in-situ resource field tests. NOTE: the 0.5 deg footprint centred on the summit spans the whole upper mountain, so footprint statistics describe the summit region as a whole, not only the test sites.
known_analog_use: NASA / CSA / DLR in-situ resource utilization field tests (Sanders et al., 2011)
2012 Moon and Mars Analog Mission Activities rover test (Graham & Graff, 2013)
